newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cooper, Vinson settle Coles action.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cooper, Vinson settle Coles action.

text.p: Retailer Coles Myer Ltd said on Friday that Premier Investments Ltd employees Harry Cooper and Marie Vinson had discontinued legal action against Coles Myer in relation to Yannon transaction transcripts.
Action against the Australian Securities Commission (ASC) in relation to the transcripts is continuing, Coles Myer said.
Coles said it had returned the transcripts to the ASC unread.

"In these circumstances, and in view of the fact that the transcripts have been returned, unread, Mr Cooper and Ms Vinson today agreed not to take any further proceedings against Coles Myers," Coles said in a statement.
"The action against the ASC is continuing," it said.
Coles Chairman Nobby Clark said in the company statement he accepted that Cooper and Vinson had started the action to protect their rights.
"In discontinuing the proceedings against Coles Myer, they are assisting the company to devote its full energies to the enhancement of shareholder value," Clark said.
Coles' shares were down three cents at A$4.59 at 12.00 p.m. (0200 GMT).
